events.name: Halloween - Alternative Craft and Small Business Market
events.description: Alternative craft and small-business market with independent maker stalls, tarot readings and free children's activities.

events.name: Bushcraft Holiday Club for Nearly Teens & Teens
events.description: Full-day bushcraft holiday club for ages 10–16 with survival skills, team building, archery, air rifle, cooking and woodcraft. Food and drinks are included. Standard child ticket £42; sibling ticket £32 when the same purse is paying. Older young people may volunteer.
events.accessibility: The organiser categorises this session under Additional Needs Sessions as well as Holiday Clubs. Contact Wrekin Forest School about individual support requirements.
events.age_guidance: Ages 10–16; older young people may volunteer

events.name: Halloween Evening Extravaganza / Night of Horrors – 29 October
events.description: Wonderland's pre-book-only evening Halloween event, with spooky trick-or-treat trail, haunted castle, live-actor scare maze, light and smoke effects, live band, fire and stilt acts, graveyard, activity room, gingerbread icing/colouring and fireworks subject to weather. Last entry 19:00. Standard adult/child tickets £20; OAP £19.50; disabled/carer £15.
events.accessibility: Wheelchair users are free; under-2s are free. Disabled/carer ticket £15. Organiser warns this evening event is designed to scare and includes live actors.
events.age_guidance: No age limit stated; organiser warns that the night event is designed to scare

events.name: Harvest Preparations & the John Moore Quire
events.description: A day of harvest preparations, rural traditions and music at Acton Scott Heritage Farm. Visitors can see the traditional harvest wagon being decorated, seasonal greenery and corn-dolly decorations, meet the farm animals and hear the John Moore Quire. The event page provides ticket booking but does not state the event price, so no price has been inferred.
